title: Ubugingo bwa Nili bwababajwe
intro: Mu gihe cy’agahato gakomeye, ubwo umunyagitugu yategekaga igihugu mu buryo bukabije, umuntu umwe yahisemo inzira y’ukwizera aho kwishima nk’umwami. Uyu muntu yabaga mu mutima w’ububasha ariko akabona ukuri mu butumwa bw’umuhanuzi wicisha bugufi. Urugendo rwabo rwabaye isomo rihoraho mu kwihangana, kwigomwa no kwizera kudacogora. Ese ushobora kumenya uyu muntu udasanzwe wakundaga ibyishimo by’Imana kuruta kuba ku isi?
clues: Nabaga mu ngoro ikomeye, nyamara umutima wanjye wabonye ukuri mu butumwa bwicishije bugufi.
Nahisemo gukurikiza ubuyobozi bwa Musa, nzi ingaruka nzahura nazo.
Nari narashakanye n'umunyagitugu ukomeye cyane mu gihe cyanjye, nyamara nanze imana ze z'ibinyoma.
Imibabaro yanjye yari ikomeye cyane, kuko nahaniwe ukwemera kwanjye Imana Imwe Rukumbi.
Sinigeze ncika intege mu kwizera kwanjye, nubwo nahuraga n'imibabaro ikomeye cyane.
Umwami wanjye yishimiye kwihangana kwanjye maze antoranyiriza umwanya w’icyubahiro muri Paradizo.

identity.label: Ndi nde?
options: Umwamikazi wo mu Misiri ya kera

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo
options: Kurwana mu nzira ya Allah hamwe n'ingabo
Guhangana na Farawo no kwemeza ko afite ukwizera
Kubaka ahantu ho gusengera mu Misiri
trial.answer: Guhangana na Farawo no kwemeza ko afite ukwizera

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Yahawe ubutegetsi ku butegetsi bwa Misiri
Yishwe umuhowe Imana kandi yubahwa na yo
outcome.answer: Yishwe umuhowe Imana kandi yubahwa na yo

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
